name: AscensionLib
description: Pokemon ascension progression and the shared library for CobbleRaids and CobbleTowers: canonical SQLite store, material wallet, capture rarity, level milestones, enemy generation and scouting. Server-side only: every screen is a web page shown by the WebGUI mod. Battle effects act in the simulator when CobbleRaids is installed (it installs the Showdown module).
